statement: On D9 Linux 7.3 with the default hid-steam lizard setting, a freshly created virtual wired UHID Steam Controller 2026 exposed gamepad and sensor evdev nodes whose capabilities and EVIOCGABS attributes were readable but which emitted no events. A 650 ms Menu press/release on that instance enabled gamepad mode, after which events flowed; no module parameter or system policy changed. This is consistent with the pinned hid-steam Menu long-hold mode switch and its input and sensor gates (steam-c6-kernel-menu-hold-450ms). Separately, a client holding the layered hidraw node removed the kernel gamepad and sensor nodes. Kernel evdev tests therefore need the mode switch and no layered hidraw holder as explicit prerequisites.

applicability.revision: Virtual wired 28de:1302 at virtualgamepad C6 ad80ae6 (linux.uhid.usb and reduced linux.uinput); no retail revision claim
applicability.firmware: Synthetic compatibility state; no live firmware claim
applicability.scope: Virtual kernel-consumer lifecycle observation on one host and kernel. Physical controller mode defaults are not measured here.
